user_intent: 如果 人在家 那么 增加 亮度
期望 温度 处于 18℃
空气质量 应 高于 72 Score
期望 湿度 处于 53 % 到 70 %
IF 人不在家 THEN 清洁环境
如果 人在家 那么 提高环境香味
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_smart_light
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() > 18 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() < 18 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF xiaomi_air_quality_sensor.get_air_score() < 72 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() < 53 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() > 70 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN start_sweep() viomi_vacuum
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_diffuser
IF zhimi_smoke_sensor.reading() >= 0.1 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_smart_light
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_diffuser
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN power_off() viomi_hood
